Name: Mahmoud Yusef Muhammad 'Abed
Notes: A Palestinian Authority police officer. Shot by soldiers and armed Israeli civilians along with another PA officer during an exchange of fire in the parking lot of the Haharim mall complex. The two officers had arrived at the complex in a car with an Israeli license plate, stabbed a security guard near the mall, seized his weapon and shot and killed him. Pronounced dead shortly afterwards. Israel is holding his body.

Wounded by shots fired by soldiers or settlers while evacuating two villagers who had been wounded while defending homes from an attack by settlers escorted by a settlement guard and soldiers. Name: Hussein Mu'taz Hussein Musa
Notes: Shot in the head by soldiers or settlers a few meters away from the separation fence. His body was found in the area. His face was covered. Earlier that day, clashes broke out in the area between young men and soldiers. Settlers were also present.

Name: Suliman Farid Suliman Malasah
Notes: Shot in the back of the head by soldiers or settlers who came out of an ambush and fired at the car in which he was traveling with other youths towards the closed gate the military installed at the entrance to the village.

Name: Labib Muhammad Labib Dmeidi
Notes: Fatally shot by soldiers or settlers while on the roof of his home with other relatives. The family members were throwing stones from the roof at settlers who were attacking their home along with soldiers.

Notes: Critically injured by gunshots fired by Border Police officers, light rail security guards and passersby, near the light rail station at Ammunition Hill, after stabbing a U.S. citizen.
